notes: Five distinct manipulation episodes are visible. Raised, open, or horizontally deployed states are treated as on; flat, closed, or folded states are treated as off. The two shelf-folding times are less exact because camera roll and brief occlusion obscure their final motion.
scene_description: First-person sequence on an apartment balcony containing a white adjustable chaise lounge and a stainless-steel gas grill. After an initial survey, the user manipulates the chaise backrest and four distinct grill parts: the cooking lid, lower cabinet door, and two separate side shelves.
